topic: compound effect of small daily wins
lines: #You don't need to change your whole life *today.*
You need to get *one percent* better.
Ten pages a day is a dozen books a *year.*
Do that for a year, and you're thirty seven times *better.*
A short walk every morning becomes a different *body.*
A little saved every week becomes a real *cushion.*
One more scroll. One more snack. One more *later.*
Those compound too. Just in the *wrong* direction.
Tomorrow, you'll either be one percent *closer*...
So don't try to win the whole year this *morning.*
One small rep. One page. One *decision.*
#Stack enough of those, and you'll look back amazed at how far you *came.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
